name: Sovremennyj Sovjonok: 2009
source:
"Modern Sovyonok: 2009" is a story without mysticism or sci-fi, grounded in realism and set during the hot July of 2009.

At the center of events is a 16-year-old boy spending time away from his family for the first time. Leaving behind the loathsome City K, he heads to Sovyonok to find something new - far from rules, parental supervision, and his past. Ultimately, he just wants to relax and break the monotony of his life.

But he could never have imagined what awaited him. Trustworthy allies. Enemies who never stop pestering him. Air thick with new ideas and feelings. Scorching heat and endless rains. Fear of punishment for disobedience biting at his heels - and feelings of love and a thirst for happiness driving him forward, urging him on. Ordinary thoughts about "the new" turn into a romantic quest for the Great "New".

In this place, within a month, he must do it all. Find his "New", change, fall in love, become happy, and, scariest of all, grow up.
translation:
《现代索维诺克：2009》是一个没有神秘主义或科幻色彩、扎根于现实主义的故事，故事发生在炎热的2009年7月。

事件的中心是一名16岁男孩第一次远离家人。离开令人厌恶的K市，他前往索维诺克寻找新的东西 - 远离规则、父母的监督和他的过去。归根结底，他只是想放松一下，打破生活的单调。

但他无法想象等待他的是什么。值得信赖的盟友。那些永远不停止纠缠他的敌人。空气中充满了新的想法和感受。酷暑难耐，大雨绵绵不绝。对不服从而受到惩罚的恐惧紧随其后，而爱的感觉和对幸福的渴望驱使着他前进，催促着他。关于“新”的普通想法变成了对伟大“新”的浪漫追求。

在这个地方，一个月之内，他必须完成这一切。找到他的“新”，改变，坠入爱河，变得快乐，最可怕的是成长。
